name: Blackmoss the Fetid keeps its Elemental creature type in bulk creature queries (#8537)
contract: Issue #8537: the Teldrassil rare Blackmoss the Fetid (3535) showed as a Critter instead of an Elemental.
Captured Ascension client creature caches (creaturecache, season-10 and coa-beta modes, 2026-09) answer 3535 with
type 4 (CreatureType.dbc Elemental), family 382 (CreatureFamily.dbc Verdant Bog Beast) and model 1549.
The client's native CMSG_CREATURE_QUERY_BULK (0x061A) must return that world template, not a collection preview
with type 8 (Critter), because the client caches the reply for the real creature entry.
CONTROL: Tsunis (5), a collection preview with no world template, still gets its preview reply (type 8, display
13444). A native single creature query for 3535 returns the same type. This checks server packet construction
in a socketless session; it does not verify a rendered client's tooltip or its existing creature cache.

steps.label: Bulk query Blackmoss the Fetid and the Tsunis preview
Blackmoss the Fetid is answered once
Blackmoss the Fetid is an Elemental
Blackmoss the Fetid keeps its Verdant Bog Beast family
CONTROL: the Tsunis preview is still answered as a Critter
CONTROL: the Tsunis preview keeps display 13444
Native single query for Blackmoss the Fetid
CONTROL: the single query answers too
CONTROL: the single query reports the same Elemental type
